lore: A pane that talks in colours instead of words.
use: Its colour follows the redstone signal strength: each of the 15 strengths shows another dye colour, no signal is dark.
secret: Place it on any side of a block; it is only 1 pixel thick and shines only while powered.

lore: A pane with a copper bulb's habit: it remembers.
use: Every redstone pulse turns it on or off, and it keeps the state without a signal. Comes plain, transparent or in the 16 dye colours.
secret: It works like the Vanilla Copper Bulb, just flat.

lore: {name} is a lamp that forgot how to be thick.
use: A flat 1 pixel lamp for any side of a block: plain, transparent or in the 16 dye colours; it shines only while it gets a redstone signal.
secret: Dye the plain pane to change its colour; a transparent pane lets the view through.

lore: A slim book that knows every switch of the flat lamps.
use: The Simple Lights Guide explains the Light Panes and their colours. Craft it shapeless from a book and a light pane.
secret: Its chapters unlock as the matching recipes land in your recipe book. Nothing is consumed.
